description: Akashi Live Facts: current facts an LLM cannot know from training, each with provenance, sources compared and as_of. POST /v1/time (zone, city or country; next DST change), /v1/holidays and /v1/business-days (three holiday sources plus exchange calendars), /v1/fx (central-bank rates with agreement and age), /v1/weather (MET Norway, plus NWS in the US), /v1/fact (current Wikidata statements), /v1/news (recent headlines plus Hacker News) and /v1/jobs (public company job boards). Every response is a JSON object, errors included ({"error":{"code","message","retryable"}} with 4xx). Upstream outages give partial results listed in unavailable, never a 5xx.

rpc_types.backend_hint: akashi-api (FastAPI) on :8000, router at /now; relayer rest url http://<api-host>:8000/now
rpc_types.notes: Only GET /v1/version, GET /v1/health, POST /v1/time, /v1/holidays, /v1/business-days, /v1/fx, /v1/weather, /v1/fact, /v1/news, /v1/jobs. Inputs only in the JSON body. Every response is a JSON object.

serving.backend: The akashi-api container (one image serves all three Akashi services under /cite, /code, /now) behind an HA RelayMiner whose rest backend points at /now. No auth toward the backend; callers cannot send headers. Needs outbound HTTPS to central banks, MET Norway, NWS, Wikidata, Nager.Date, OpenHolidays and Hacker News; a scheduled task keeps the news and jobs indexes on a /data volume.

healthcheck.notes: Functional probe: pinned tz database, deterministic.

serving.notes: p95 under 3 s, hard stop 4 s; request bodies up to 64 KiB. Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"]; see deploy/gateway/sage-service.yaml.
